mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the monetary policy environment supports risk-taking.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 5.0% over the past 3 months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates broad-based demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: A manufacturing supply shock (INDPRO decline > 2.0% from peak) creates production bottlenecks that reduce corporate output and margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines > 2.0% from peak, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Higher current CPIAUCSL levels (above 2.0) signal persistent inflationary pressures that reduce real equity valuations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.0, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market growth (PAYEMS increase > 100k per month) signals robust consumer spending and corporate earnings momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth > 100k, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous CPIAUCSL increase above 2.5% and FEDFUNDS decrease below 0.5% signals stagflationary pressures where inflation rises while monetary policy remains accommodative, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: A housing market boom (HOUST above 600k units) drives consumer confidence and spending growth, boosting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 600k, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
